clear.advice: Great weather! Stay hydrated, use sunscreen, and enjoy the outdoors.

sunny.advice: Wear sunscreen, drink plenty of water, and consider wearing sunglasses.

clouds.advice: The weather is cloudy. You can go outside, but keep a light jacket nearby.

rain.advice: Take an umbrella or raincoat and be careful on wet roads and slippery surfaces.

drizzle.advice: A light jacket or umbrella may be useful. Roads may be slippery.

thunderstorm.advice: Stay indoors if possible. Avoid open areas, tall trees, and unnecessary travel.

snow.advice: Dress warmly and be careful because roads and walkways may be slippery.

mist.advice: Visibility may be reduced. Drive carefully and use your headlights when necessary.

fog.advice: Visibility may be poor. Slow down when driving and keep a safe following distance.

wind.advice: Be careful around trees and loose objects. Secure outdoor items if necessary.

hot.advice: Drink plenty of water, avoid prolonged direct sunlight, and stay cool.

cold.advice: Wear warm clothing and limit prolonged exposure to the cold.

default.advice: Check the forecast before going outside and dress appropriately for the conditions.
